study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Bank identity is not pair-level overlap. Different digests can contain identical pairs. No URL was fetched; no independence or settlement claim is derived.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

manifest.selection: Sixteen wholly new authored incident worlds, two separate claim renderings per world, frozen before tokenizer loading; no selection or revision based on counts.
manifest.comparator_policy: Preserve the source English templates verbatim apart from new incident, check, time, cause and test references. All reference bytes match across each pair, HH:MM times stay identical. Count the complete standalone claim, as in the source, not shared reference-resolution context.
manifest.population_clarification: The inherited population string says six domains but enumerates seven; preserve the seven actual source labels and per-form counts 3/1/1/2/3/3/3. This clarification does not rewrite the source or its stable comparison identity.
manifest.limits: This replicates the source single-impact/single-cause 32-claim cost slice, not the entire four-coverage-cell, >=192-world reader study or its required same-semantic-cell cost. Both-claims and neither-claim cells are absent here because absent from this source. No reader evidence, routing, causal attribution, future tokenizer, robustness or adoption claim follows. Source template wording is retained for comparability; the source label shortest adequate is not proof of globally minimal English wording.
manifest.dependence: Thirty-two complete string pairs from sixteen linked fictional incident worlds; the two form versions are not independent natural incidents.

freshness_audit.scope: Exact complete pairs/arms on all current and predecessor token records, plus public discussion/examples; not independent natural-language sampling.
